name: lazaretto-guard
description: Reads a remote MCP server's tools for tool poisoning and hidden orders before your agent connects it, pins them, and asks before the first use of a server whose tools have changed since (re-read once a day at session start). Before an install, checks pinned package versions against published malicious-package advisories. Asks rather than blocks on anything found. Sends package names and versions, and a remote server's URL with a free key (at the add, once a day for pinned servers, and for remote servers already in Claude Code's config, after saying so once); never a URL that carries a secret. Never blocks, never exits non-zero.
